headline: Less time on records. More time for students.
linkedin:
Taking attendance daily often comes down to quick entry and not losing what was marked. With AttendEase, I worked on a browser-based tracker where inputs auto-save per date, paired with instant search and live attendance stats on the screen.

For getting data out of the browser, I wired up direct Excel exports, CSV backups, and printable views so records can be archived or shared offline. The complete code is available on GitHub.

Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/attendance-system
instagram:
AttendEase is an attendance tracker I made that runs in the browser. It automatically saves entries by date as you mark them, shows live stats and search filters, and lets you pull records out via Excel export, CSV backup, or print.

Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/attendance-system
